penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Diagnosing Agentforce-Flow integration failures requires per-customer investigation of org-specific configurations, custom objects, and flow logic — each engagement is bespoke manual consulting work.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Debugging enterprise Salesforce orgs requires back-and-forth, access to org data, and ongoing human judgement — not automatable via Claude alone.

rationale: Salesforce developers and admins at enterprise orgs are real paid professionals, and Agentforce-Flow failures are genuinely painful for their delivery timelines. However, this is a consulting/debugging problem: every customer's Salesforce org is different, and diagnosing failures requires org access, manual investigation, and iterative back-and-forth — all heavy human-fulfillment work. After penalties, total collapses to 2.7, and operational_autonomy (4) fails its build gate. This cannot run hands-off.
solution_plan: Not viable as an autonomous factory micro-service. The core problem — debugging why Agentforce fails when called from a specific org's Flow — is inherently bespoke per customer; it requires org access, reading custom configurations, and iterative trial-and-error that a solo operator cannot automate. At best this is a freelance consulting offer, which the factory is not designed to fulfill. Drop.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy (4 < 7) and buildability_with_ai (5 < 6) build gates. Total after penalties is 2.7, well below validate threshold.
